prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, high ponytail swept sleek — her body is covered in applied metallic leaf in 2 different colours at once, each colour claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 2 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 52% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 2 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 10 o'clock and 5 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied CHAMPAGNE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright CHAMPAGNE sheen filling every gap. Region 2 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied TURQUOISE metallic leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright TURQUOISE sheen filling every gap. Where two regions meet, the leaf colours interlock naturally: flakes of one reach into the other and the two colours simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every sheet of leaf applied to her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots covered in the same leaf colours at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every leaf sheet and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
